Three-paper Phase 1 candidate and coverage inventory

state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The protocol's resources are: an untrusted, more-capable model U, which might try to backdoor solutions (GPT-4, version 0613); a trusted, less-capable model T, which is known not to try to backdoor solutions (GPT-3.5, version 0613), trusted because less-capable models are unlikely to be able to subvert safety measures without their subversion attempts being easily noticed; limited access to trusted high-quality labor H, which in practice is human labor that is more capable than GPT-3.5 but much more expensive, and which the paper models by allowing the protocol to access GPT-4 through a channel that will not be affected by the red team, because GPT-4 is cheaper; and the ability to run test cases, provided by the APPS dataset, for exactly one submitted solution per problem.
title: Trusted model and simulated human resource
